{{Top|leg}}
An '''Imperial listening post''' was built on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Garos IV]], located south-east of the [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Ariana]]. Three stories tall, it was used by [[Jaalib Brandl]] to secure [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Tork Winger]] and his daughter, [[Alexandra Winger|Alexandra]], after the bombing of [[Chado's Pub]].<ref name="BBK">{{JournalCite|12|Betrayal by Knight}}</ref>
